result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well. Found a few minor layout and consistency issues related to horizontally cut-off content and inconsistent styling.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third item ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge with truncated text, which may look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible peek/gradient or partial card styling to clearly indicate horizontal scrolling, and ensure text truncation uses an ellipsis consistently.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons are inconsistent between cards: the Tokumaru Ramen card has a white heart on light background (low visibility) while the pizza card has a filled dark circle background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button styling with a consistent background treatment for readability across all cards.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card ('Popular right now') is cut off by the viewport/navigation bar, showing only the top portion.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for scrollable content, but ensure adequate bottom padding so cards aren't obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.
